full_judgment:
S.K. Sinha J: Petitioners are the heirs of defendant in a suit for declaration of title and recovery of khas possession of the suit land, preferred this petition for leave to appeal from the judgment of the High Court Division in First Appeal No.415 of 2003 reversing those of the learned Subordinate Judge, Fourth Court, Dhaka in Title Suit No.503 of 1999. 

 6. Now the question is whether the plaintiffs are entitled to a decree for recovery of khas possession in view of the fact that the High Court Division has not arrived at any definite finding as to when they have been dispossessed by the defendant. Since the defendant did not file documentary evidence in support of his title, even if his claim of taking possession of the suit land on 8th January, 1979 is taken to be true, the suit having been instituted within a period of 12 years from that date, the plaintiffs have acquired better title than the defendant. The High Court Division, in the premises, is perfectly justified in decreeing the suit. We find no merit in the contention of Mr. Mahbubey Alam.
